sources.locator: §2.4, printed pp. 20–21; §4.4, printed pp. 78–81, especially Lemma 4.35, Proposition 4.36, Theorems 4.38 and 4.41.

contents.name: Positive functional and normalized state on a unital star algebra
contents.support: The local definition supplies the explicit tensor test algebra and moment family; the source supplies the algebraic positive-functional convention.

contents.name: Quotient domain, induced pairing, left multiplication, and adjoint identity
contents.support: The source gives the generic GNS construction. The local proof uses the inspected in-run GNS supplier and proves the additional continuity from the tempered moment inputs.

contents.name: Closability on a common domain
contents.support: The local conclusion inherits the exact closability and adjoint-restriction hypotheses from the GNS supplier; no self-adjointness is inferred.

source_review.read_extent: The complete 388-page book carrier was available; §4.4, printed pp. 78–81, and the relevant positive-functional sections were inspected in sequence.
source_review.supports: Generic positive-functional GNS quotient, common-domain left multiplication, adjoint identity, cyclic state recovery, and unitary uniqueness.
source_review.limitations: This is a generic algebraic representation treatment, not a proof of the local Schwartz moment-continuity, Poincaré pullback, locality, or QFT Fourier-support steps.

sources.title: Jens Mund, General Aspects of Relativistic Quantum Field Theory, lecture notes, DF-UFJF (2012)
sources.locator: §2.1, Theorem 2.6 and proof, PDF pp. 15–17; see the source's p. 1 note that these are incomplete course notes.

contents.name: Tensor test algebra, positive Wightman functional, and GNS reconstruction route
contents.support: The notes define the finite-sequence tensor test algebra and form the linear positive functional from the Wightman distributions.

contents.name: Weak common-domain field and exact vacuum moments
contents.support: The proof constructs the field from degree-one left multiplication on the GNS domain and identifies its vacuum moments with the supplied distributions.

contents.name: Poincaré pullback and conditional covariance
contents.support: The source displays the Poincaré pullback convention; the local definition fixes the exact group law and signature.

contents.name: Fourier-support spectrum premise
contents.support: The source presents the forward-cone Fourier-support condition; the local definition records the precise no-2π Minkowski transposition convention.

contents.name: Poincaré pullback continuity and covariance
contents.support: The notes use the pullback on Schwartz test functions. The assigned lemma supplies a complete seminorm proof of the parameter continuity required by the local strong-continuity argument.

source_review.read_extent: The complete 39-page PDF was retrieved and inspected for the full Theorem 2.6 statement and proof on pp. 15–17, including the tensor-algebra functional, GNS quotient, covariance, locality, and conditional spectrum discussion.
source_review.supports: The QFT-specific moment-to-field construction and its standard additional Wightman identities.
source_review.limitations: The author labels the notes incomplete. The source theorem assumes Hermiticity, positivity, covariance, causality, spectral, and cluster conditions and concludes more than this item. The local theorem proves only its individually stated conditional conclusions and supplies every used argument.

contents.name: Source-printed radial Yukawa expression

source_review.read_extent: The complete 47-page PDF was retrieved. The GNS argument on printed pp. 7–9 and the Yukawa formula/convolution discussion on PDF pp. 10–11 were inspected.
source_review.supports: An independent algebraic GNS treatment and the exact source passage corrected by the B-page counterexample.
source_review.limitations: Its GNS section does not prove the assigned Schwartz moment-continuity estimate; the counterexample makes no claim about the delta distribution at the singular origin.

sources.title: Christopher J. Fewster and Kasia Rejzner, Algebraic Quantum Field Theory—an introduction, arXiv:1904.04051v2 (2019)

contents.name: Off-origin countercalculation for the displayed radial power
contents.support: The local proof differentiates r^-2 exp(-mu r) for r>0, obtains a strictly nonzero residual, and checks r^-1 exp(-mu r) only off the origin.

source_review.supports: The exact radial power appearing in the cited source.
source_review.limitations: No delta normalization or full distributional Green-function result is inferred.

note: Two independent A-page treatments were read in full at the relevant locators: Schmudgen's published book and Mund's complete lecture-note PDF; Fewster–Rejzner supplies a third independent GNS treatment. The local theorem proves the precise weaker claim from the inspected actual suppliers and explicit hypotheses. Source citations do not certify the proof. The B counterexample is restricted to r>0.
